Two Workers Rescued Alive From Nepal Hydropower Tunnel After Nine Days

Two workers were rescued alive from a hydropower tunnel in Nepal nine days after a disaster, with one survivor stating he chanted the Hare Krishna mantra for survival. The rescue operation involved overcoming multiple challenges to reach the trapped individuals. The workers were identified as Sanjay Sah and another individual, with one report mentioning Sanjay Sah, 30, stayed behind to ensure others escaped. Search operations for others are ongoing. The rescue was described as extraordinary by an expert.
